name: comp-581
title: Minimal Auth Navbar
blurb: Minimal navbar with logo, nav links, info/notification/user menus.
description: Clean header with logo, simple nav links, and icon-based menus (info, notifications, user). Responsive mobile menu.
use_when: SaaS or apps needing a polished, uncluttered header with user account features.
avoid_when: Heavy content navigation or mega menus.
a11y: Keyboard-navigable menu. Mobile menu managed with aria-expanded. Icon buttons labeled.
